row.name: Slender colubrid
mustPaint: very slender whip body in a fast S-curve
narrow rounded head with a large round eye
plain smooth glossy scales (no python net)
masks: striped = lengthwise garter stripes, banded = king-snake rings
row.why: 2 misleading and 7 caveat. Replaces the heavy netted python for every slim snake.
